consequence.statement: This is a new opt-in field that defaults to false, so existing policies behave as before. Turning it on adds admission warnings and, according to the schema description, makes admission requests take longer to process.

original.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 adds an optional boolean field, spec.emitWarning (default false), to ClusterPolicy and Policy; when enabled, warnings are returned with admission responses for mutations and for violations of Audit-mode validate rules.

decision.reason: [ev-e47234304fa3] presents spec.emitWarning as a new capability. The CRD diffs [ev-fb4370b76542][ev-4cfdef775223][ev-6aaf9d482a51][ev-50d874fa9a77] show it as a newly added boolean field with default false on both ClusterPolicy and Policy, so policies left as they are behave as before. The extended processing time described in the schema only happens if an operator turns the field on. The evidence names nothing that fails or changes for an environment that does nothing, so kind none, class informational and severity low are supported.
